subject: microbiology
title: Salmonella Typhi, Enteric Fever, Vi Antigen and Typhoid Carriers

steps.tx: **Salmonella Typhi** is a human restricted, motile, non lactose fermenting Salmonella with Vi capsular polysaccharide, weak H2S, no gas from glucose, causing enteric (typhoid) fever: stepwise fever, relative bradycardia, rose spots, hepatosplenomegaly, intestinal perforation risk in week three, bacteraemia from week one in blood culture and bile seeded gallbladder chronic carriers.
steps.say: Human only, Vi coated, blood in week one: typhoid is bacteraemia with intestinal late complications.

vis.caption: Salmonellosis pathogenesis, Salmonella invasion biology shared with typhoidal disease.

steps.tx: **Paratyphi A, B and C** cause paratyphoid, clinically inseparable milder (A now dominates Asia, B tartrate variants, C rare), vaccines for Typhi do not cover A, stool shedding and food and water routes shared, diagnosis identical. Enteric fever names the syndrome pair.
steps.say: Paratyphi wears the same fever with a different surname and no vaccine cover.

left.title: Serovar map
points: Typhi: Vi positive usually, human only
Paratyphi B: tartrate positive systemic, negative enteric form

right.title: Shared epidemiology
points: Water and food contaminated by cases and carriers
Sanitation and safe water decide incidence
Travellers import to low incidence countries

steps.tx: **Culture timing** in enteric fever is week craft: blood culture week one highest (volume sensitive, bile broth heritage because bile salts inhibit others and Typhi tolerates), bone marrow most sensitive even after antibiotics, stool week two to three, urine later, Widal supportive only (serology module). Prior antibiotics slash yields.
steps.say: Blood first week, marrow anytime, stool later: typhoid culture is a calendar.

steps.tx: The **Widal test** revisited from serology (TO and TH titres, local cut offs, paired rise) underperforms in endemic zones due to background and cross reactions, newer rapids (Typhidot IgM, TUBEX) imperfect, culture remains reference. Ordering Widal alone for fever week one is the error this lesson exists to retire.
steps.say: Widal is a witness of low reliability; blood culture is the court.

right.title: Better hierarchy
points: Marrow in treated or late cases
Rapid antigen and IgM as adjuncts only

steps.tx: The **Vi antigen** (capsular polysaccharide) masks O antigens (heat the suspension to unmask for O agglutination), antiphagocytic, lost on subculture (V to W variation), target of polysaccharide and conjugate vaccines, whose antibodies protect without treating carriage reliably.
steps.say: Vi hides the O beneath it; unconjugated Vi vaccine speaks IgM only.

left.title: Vi biology
points: Capsule over cell wall O antigen
Some Typhi Vi negative strains exist

right.title: Vi vaccines
points: Vi polysaccharide: 2 years plus, 3 year boosters, T independent
Vi conjugate (TCV): infants from 6 months, WHO recommended endemic
Ty21a live oral: no Vi (mucosal, multiple doses)

steps.tx: The **typhoid carrier** (2 to 5 percent, gallbladder stones niche, women and older, Typhoid Mary archetype) sheds intermittently for years, detected by stool cultures repeated and Vi antibody traditions, treated by fluoroquinolone or ceftriaxone susceptibility era plus cholecystectomy when stones and refractory, excluded from food work until clearance.
steps.say: Gallstones shelter Typhi for decades; carriers are cured by antibiotics plus sometimes the gallbladder.

left.title: Carrier biology
points: Urinary carriage with schistosomiasis or stones regional
Risk after acute disease graded by age and sex

right.title: Carrier management
points: Antibiotics by susceptibility, 4 to 6 weeks traditions
Food handler exclusion and follow up registries

steps.tx: **Typhoid resistance eras** successively retired chloramphenicol (MDR plasmid 1970s), fluoroquinolones (decreased susceptibility Asia, treatment failures), and now ceftriaxone XDR lineages (Pakistan 2016 onward, azithromycin often last oral), geography read before prescription in every traveller.
steps.say: Each typhoid drug era ended by plasmid or mutation; XDR leaves azithromycin and meropenem.

right.title: Current logic
points: Uncomplicated by regional map: azithromycin or cefixime (susceptible zones)

steps.tx: **Enteric fever complications** time themselves: intestinal haemorrhage and ileal perforation week three (surgical emergency, peritonitis board), encephalopathy, myocarditis, hepatitis, marrow suppression with leukopenia (not leukocytosis usually), relative bradycardia and rose spots the gentle signs before. Leukopenia in fever is the blood count whispering typhoid.
steps.say: Week three abdomen is perforation until excluded; leukopenia whispers what fever shouts.

left.title: Classic signs
points: Step ladder fever first week traditions
